title: DeepMind adds real-time planning and native audio to Genie 4
dek: A generated environment is continuously steered by a separate Gemini planning loop, but reliable long-horizon physics remains unresolved.
evidence: Google DeepMind research preview and demonstrations; no independent physical-fidelity evaluation
takeaway: Use world models as variable test environments only when their rules and state transitions can be validated independently.

sections.title: Context

bullets.detail: An interactive world model can supply varied situations for training, but a convincing video is not necessarily a physically consistent simulator.

paragraphs: Why it matters for agents: An interactive world model can supply varied situations for training, but a convincing video is not necessarily a physically consistent simulator.

sections.title: What's new

bullets.detail: DeepMind's Genie 4 generates interactive video, ambience and dialogue in one simulation. Gemini Omni provides grounding for realistic appearance and behavior.
Additional Gemini models observe evolving frames and help maintain the scene's coherence as a user acts or edits the world. Genie remains a research preview for selected testers.

paragraphs: Native multimodal generation: DeepMind's Genie 4 generates interactive video, ambience and dialogue in one simulation. Gemini Omni provides grounding for realistic appearance and behavior.
Planner separation: Additional Gemini models observe evolving frames and help maintain the scene's coherence as a user acts or edits the world. Genie remains a research preview for selected testers.

sections.title: Evidence & limitations

bullets.detail: DeepMind shows interactive scenarios, but does not publish an independent closed-loop robotics success or physical-fidelity comparison.
Object permanence, long-session consistency, text rendering, complex physics, geometry and real-time audio still drift, particularly after many edits.

paragraphs: Demonstrated, not calibrated: DeepMind shows interactive scenarios, but does not publish an independent closed-loop robotics success or physical-fidelity comparison.
Known failures: Object permanence, long-session consistency, text rendering, complex physics, geometry and real-time audio still drift, particularly after many edits.

sections.title: Why it matters

bullets.lead: Photorealism is not a test oracle
bullets.detail: Use world models for diverse candidate scenarios; verify critical state transitions against deterministic environments or real-world data.
Score object identity, state persistence, action validity and recovery—not simply frame aesthetics.
